outcome: need for high frequency oscillatory ventilation
cohort: 24 neonates with congenital diaphragmatic hernia admitted to the Department of Paediatric Surgeries, GMMMC Sukkur and Bolan Medical College Hospital Quetta, Pakistan from January 1, 2018 to June 30, 2018.
finding: Surgical treatment of congenital diaphragmatic hernia in neonates resulted in a good survival rate (90%).
mod_finding: 16 neonates (66.67%) were born by C-section and 8 (33.33%) were born by vaginal delivery; however, mode of delivery was not associated with survival.
gest_age: Mean gestational age for survivors was 35.85+/-2.56 weeks and 37.23+/-1.07 weeks for non-survivors.
